== Attribute References

The product is {product}. Undefined: {undefined-attr}. Escaped: \{product}.

:product: Gadget
Redefined product: {product}.

:product!:
Unset product: {product}.

{set:dynamic:value} Dynamic attribute is {dynamic}.
{counter:seq} {counter:seq} {counter:seq} -- current {seq}.
{counter:letters:a} {counter:letters} {counter2:letters} {letters}.

Character replacements: {nbsp}{zwsp}{amp}{lt}{gt}{plus}{brvbar}{vbar}{caret}{tilde}{apostrophe}{backslash}{backtick}{two-colons}{two-semicolons}{cpp}{pp}.

Attribute with formatting: {url-home}[*bold link*, window=_blank].

== Conditionals

ifdef::feature-x[]
Feature X is enabled.
endif::feature-x[]

ifndef::feature-y[]
Feature Y is not enabled.
endif::feature-y[]

ifdef::feature-x,feature-y[Either X or Y is set.]

ifdef::feature-x+feature-y[]
Both X and Y are set (should not render).
endif::feature-x+feature-y[]

ifeval::[{product-version} > 4]
Version is greater than four.
endif::[]

ifeval::["{backend}" == "html5"]
Backend is HTML5.
endif::[]

ifeval::[{sectnumlevels} + 1 == 4]
Arithmetic in ifeval works.
endif::[]

ifdef::empty-attr[]
Empty attributes are still defined.
endif::[]
